title: Stage 4: validate the #46 evidence-language wording with real founders
body:
## Outcome
Real founders confirm, or correct, whether the evidence language shipped for #46 is understood: required evidence versus suggested preparation, and the editorial "Terms in plain language" (commercialisation, matched contribution).

## Delivery
Status: Backlog — not dispatched. Needs Stage 4 recruitment ([delivery plan](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/blob/main/docs/06-delivery.md): "Recruitment of consenting founders and navigators (P2 and P3 first)"; "Early feedback starts with P2 and P3, five participants each").
Priority: P2
Refs #46 (closed: wording delivered in #47), #26, #27.

## Why this exists
#46's acceptance deferred one item: "validate comprehension with real participants later". The wording was delivered in #47 (`9ae3e03`) and verified on `main` `0a7d9a6`. Its evidence comes only from synthetic actors (T01/T03, first round #26) and primed regressions. That is not human comprehension.

## Acceptance
- Include these points in the Stage 4 session guide for P2/P3 founders, with consent. Don't coach participants with the intended interpretation.
- Observe whether participants can tell a source-stated requirement from a suggested preparation step on the A2 and support answers, and whether the terms disclosure is found and understood without implying eligibility, amounts or IP ownership.
- Record each observation separately from interpretation. Report participants who did not reach the screen.
- File any misunderstanding as its own finding, with reproduction and retest acceptance.

## Exclusions
No synthetic actor substitutes for this. No live-source correctness claim.
